fit.gap_handling_summary: The documents present strong, relevant production NLP, Azure serving and drift-monitoring experience without inventing production RAG, LLM fine-tuning, Kubernetes or AWS experience. The personal RAG project's manual-only evaluation and non-production status are explicit. Four years of production-shipping ML-engineer experience is not established: the clearly documented ML-engineer role began in March 2023, while the earlier banking role does not explicitly establish production deployment. Data versioning, CI/CD, automated testing, orchestration, cost evaluation and cross-team integration remain unproven; the outputs appropriately avoid claiming them.

artefacts: The extracted PDF joins words in one achievement line: "Achieved94%accuracyandmacroF1of0.91; theserviceprocessesapproximately15,000documentsperday."
issues: The technical-skills section is split after its first category, leaving most skills on page two without a repeated heading.
The first page is dense while the second is only 36.6% filled.
The source-supplied wording "fictional proceedings" is faithfully retained but is conspicuous and potentially confusing in an employer-facing publication citation.

reasons: Strong coverage of Python, Azure, MLflow, transformer fine-tuning, production serving and monitoring.
Several matches are semantic rather than literal: Git supports version control, and annotated-corpus construction supports text dataset preparation.
TF-IDF demonstrates feature engineering, but that explicit keyword appears only in the letter.
A strict four-year production-ML-engineer filter is not clearly satisfied by the documented roles.
RAG is present but correctly limited to a personal prototype.
Reading order and most words are intact, but one metric-heavy PDF line has merged words and numbers, preventing an unqualified parseability pass.

issues: The letter largely repeats the CV instead of selecting fewer examples and explaining their relevance in more depth.
The PhD topic is stated twice.
Company specificity is limited to the advertised merchant-support mission and Customer Operations team; no distinctive company information or values are used.
The long paragraph beginning with the banking role also covers later NER work, doctoral research and the personal RAG project, weakening structure.
The certification interrupts the connection between establishing drift monitoring and the incident that monitoring detected.
strengths: Names the correct company, role and team.
Connects complaint classification with customer-support work.
Uses concrete production scale, accuracy and monitoring outcomes.
Clearly distinguishes transformer fine-tuning from the non-production RAG prototype.
Does not reuse the earlier letter's outdated banking-employment or local-work framing.

statements_in_outputs: Machine Learning Engineer | Slavonica Document AI d.o.o. | Osijek
Data Scientist | Baranjska kreditna banka d.d. | Zagreb

spacing_issues: CV page one is substantially denser than page two, which is only 36.6% filled and has a large unused lower area.
The technical-skills section starts near the bottom of page one, but most of its categories continue at the top of page two without a heading.
issues: The 10-point CV body is readable but makes the dense first page less comfortable to scan.
A deliberate page break before Technical Skills, or a more balanced redistribution of sections, would improve the two-page presentation.
The cover letter is clean, readable and comfortably contained on one page.

fluency_and_tone_issues: The letter repeats the doctoral topic in "am completing a PhD ... focused on named entity recognition in Croatian legal texts" and "My doctoral research, currently in progress, focuses on named entity recognition in Croatian legal texts."

The sentence beginning "Using Python, PyTorch, and Hugging Face Transformers, I introduced MLflow ..." compresses several distinct development and infrastructure activities into one cumbersome sentence.
"I also" recurs repeatedly in the middle paragraphs, making the letter read like an inventory rather than a focused argument.

notes_facts_used: The PhD is unfinished, with expected completion in 2027; the candidate is not styled as Dr.
The Azure AI Engineer Associate certification was obtained in 2024.
The candidate delivered a 90-minute NLP summer-school guest lecture in 2025.
English is used daily in client meetings.
The RAG work is only a personal prototype, not production experience.
The outputs respect the limits on LLM fine-tuning, Kubernetes and AWS experience.

evaluation.summary: These are accurate, relevant documents with strong evidence of production NLP, Azure deployment, dataset annotation and model monitoring. They correctly preserve the unfinished PhD and distinguish a personal RAG prototype from production AI-product experience. The main application gaps are the unestablished four years of production-shipping ML-engineer experience and missing evidence for data versioning, CI/CD, automated tests and ingestion pipelines. Presentation would improve with a more balanced CV page break, repair of the merged PDF extraction line, and a less repetitive, more selective cover letter.
